confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live price checks. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July is high season and rates vary widely between the walled city, Getsemani and Bocagrande. The FX observation was taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates table for 2026-10-15 and was not verified against the page text.
comparable_city_reasoning: Positioned between mainstream Colombian urban pricing (Medellin, Bogota) and Caribbean tourist-destination pricing, with a premium for Old Town and Getsemani tourist demand during the July high season.
